definition: Patient/slide. Cells and ROIs are within-slide subsamples.
Up to five non-overlapping ROIs selected using DAPI tissue density only.
At least 2 of SOX9, MMP3, KRT6B positive in the same segmented cell.
PDGFRA positive and at least one of P63/KLF4/KRT14 positive in the same cell.
KRT77, SCGB2A2 and S100A7 all positive in the same cell.
Panel-wide Otsu thresholds on pooled per-cell mean 8-bit intensity.
Front_candidate is assigned only when healing status is not documented and requires anatomical review.
Holm within region contrasts; BH across three panels for depth and time families.
